From a1f3316dd7b5ce740c774697c664e2e60d095794 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "David S. Miller" <davem@davemloft.net>
Date: Thu, 21 Sep 2017 18:18:23 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ipv4: Move fib_has_custom_local_routes outside of
 IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES.

> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'fib_validate_source':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:411:16: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    if (net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes)
>                 ^
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'inet_rtm_newroute':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:773:12: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes = true;
>             ^

Fixes: 6e617de84e87 ("net: avoid a full fib lookup when rp_filter is disabled.")
Reported-by: Stephen Rothwell <sfr@canb.auug.org.au>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/include/net/netns/ipv4.h b/include/net/netns/ipv4.h
index 20720721da4b..8387f099115e 100644
--- a/include/net/netns/ipv4.h
+++ b/include/net/netns/ipv4.h
@@ -49,10 +49,10 @@ struct netns_ipv4 {
 #ifdef CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES
 	struct fib_rules_ops	*rules_ops;
 	bool			fib_has_custom_rules;
-	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_main;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_default;
 #endif
+	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 #ifdef CONFIG_IP_ROUTE_CLASSID
 	int			fib_num_tclassid_users;
 #endif
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/net/netns/ipv4.h`**
   - The member `fib_has_custom_local_routes` was moved outside of the `#ifdef CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` preprocessor directive. 
   - This change ensures that `fib_has_custom_local_routes` is always part of the `struct netns_ipv4`, regardless of whether `CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` is defined.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `include/net/netns/ipv4.h` addresses the errors reported in the `fib_frontend.c` file, where the compiler could not find the `fib_has_custom_local_routes` member in the `struct netns_ipv4`. By moving the member declaration outside of the conditional compilation block, the struct is now correctly defined, resolving the compilation errors encountered in the functions `fib_validate_source` and `inet_rtm_newroute`. This change is part of a fix for a previous commit that aimed to optimize routing behavior when reverse path filtering is disabled.

Here is the commit message:
ipv4: Move fib_has_custom_local_routes outside of
 IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES.

> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'fib_validate_source':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:411:16: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    if (net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes)
>                 ^
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'inet_rtm_newroute':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:773:12: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes = true;
>             ^

Fixes: 6e617de84e87 ("net: avoid a full fib lookup when rp_filter is disabled.")
Reported-by: Stephen Rothwell <sfr@canb.auug.org.au>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the `fib_has_custom_local_routes` member being conditionally defined within the `#ifdef CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` directive. This led to instances where the member was not available in the `struct netns_ipv4`, resulting in compilation errors when the code attempted to access or modify this member in functions like `fib_validate_source` and `inet_rtm_newroute`.

Here is the patch:

 	bool			fib_has_custom_rules;
-	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_main;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_default;
 #endif
+	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 #ifdef CONFIG_IP_ROUTE_CLASSID
 	int			fib_num_tclassid_users;

Reason:
The member `fib_has_custom_local_routes` is conditionally defined within the `#ifdef CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` directive. If this directive is not defined, the member does not exist in the `struct netns_ipv4`, leading to compilation errors when the code attempts to access or modify it in the functions `fib_validate_source` and `inet_rtm_newroute`.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
bool fib_has_custom_local_routes;
```
```c
#endif
```
Reason:
By moving the definition of `fib_has_custom_local_routes` outside of the `#ifdef CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` directive, the member is made available in all configurations, ensuring that the code can safely access and modify it without causing compilation errors.
